source: Ravi, Desikan. Curvilinear regression analysis of benzenoid hydrocarbons and computation of some reduced reverse degree based topological indices for hyaluronic acid-paclitaxel conjugates. Sci. Rep. 13 (2023) 3239
convention: reduced reverse degree RR(v) = Delta(G) - d(v) + 2 (= Kulli c_v + 1): NOT implemented in TopoQSPR
benzenoid_identification: rows identified by molecular weight and heavy-atom count in Table 1 (rows 3 and 4 are the two C14H10 isomers; the order anthracene/phenanthrene is fixed by the values)
hap_partition_note: count = a*n + b for [a, b]; pairs are reduced reverse degrees
